script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

ALICE (30s, thoughtful, creative), sitting at a table, typing on a laptop. Across the room, JAMES (30s, charming, successful) enters. He catches Alice's eye as he orders a coffee. They lock gazes, and Alice looks away.

ALICE
(to herself)
Oh, God. It's him.

James approaches Alice's table, setting down a coffee cup.

JAMES
Mind if I join you?

ALICE
(surprised)
Uh, sure.

They sit, awkwardly.

ALICE
(smiling)
So, what brings you to this side of town?

JAMES
Just grabbing a coffee before work. And you?

ALICE
Just trying to meet a deadline.

James smiles, admiring her.

JAMES
You've always been a hard worker.

They share a moment, reminiscing about old times.

SCENE 2 - INT. ALICE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Alice shows James around her apartment. They reminisce about their past and talk about their lives.

ALICE
(looking at a photo)
This is my old high school sweetheart, Matt. We were together for five years.

James looks sympathetic.

JAMES
I'm sorry it didn't work out.

ALICE
(sighs)
It's been five years. I've moved on.

JAMES
(looking at her)
I'd love to see where life has taken you.

SCENE 3 - EXT. PARK - DAY

They walk in the park, laughing and enjoying each other's company.

ALICE
(giggling)
Remember that time we got lost in the woods?

JAMES
(laughing)
Yeah, that was a disaster. But we made it out okay, didn't we?

ALICE
We did.

They sit on a bench, and James takes Alice's hand.

JAMES
You know, Alice, I've always regretted the way things ended between us.

ALICE
(looking at him)
And I've always wondered what could have been.

They share a moment of understanding.

SCENE 4 - INT. CAFE - NIGHT

They sit in a café, sharing stories and memories. James reaches for her hand, and she takes it.

JAMES
(looking into her eyes)
I'd like another chance, Alice. A chance to make things right.

ALICE
(hesitantly)
I'd like that too.

SCENE 5 - EXT. SUNSET - NIGHT

They stand on a hill, watching the sunset.

JAMES
(looking at her)
I've missed you, Alice. More than you know.

ALICE
(looking at him)
And I've missed you, James. More than you know.

They share a gentle, romantic kiss.

SCENE 6 - INT. ALICE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

They sit on her couch, talking and laughing.

ALICE
(tearfully)
I'm so glad you're back in my life, James.

JAMES
(reassuringly)
And I'm so glad I found you again, Alice.

SCENE 7 - INT. DINNER - NIGHT

They go out for dinner, enjoying each other's company. They laugh and share stories about their lives.

JAMES
(looking at her)
I can't believe how much we've both grown.

ALICE
(smiling)
Neither can I.

SCENE 8 - EXT. STARS - NIGHT

They lay on a blanket, looking up at the stars.

JAMES
(looking at her)
I love you, Alice.

ALICE
(looking at him)
I love you, James.

They share a tender, passionate kiss.

SCENE 9 - INT. ALICE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

They lie in bed, talking about their plans for the future.

ALICE
(looking at him)
I'm so happy you're here with me.

JAMES
(looking at her)
I'm so happy I found you again.

SCENE 10 - EXT. MORNING - SUNRISE

They watch the sunrise, holding each other.

ALICE
(whispering)
I never thought I'd have a second chance at love.

JAMES
(whispering)
And I never thought I'd find someone worth giving a second chance to.

SCENE 11 - INT. ALICE'S APARTMENT - DAY

They spend the day together, enjoying each other's company and making plans for their future.

ALICE
(excitedly)
I can't believe how right this feels.

JAMES
(smiling)
I know. And I never want to let go.

SCENE 12 - INT. DINNER - NIGHT

They go out for dinner with friends, who are happy to see them back together.

ALICE
(looking at James)
I'm so glad I got a second chance at love.

JAMES
(looking at her)
And I'm so glad I found someone worth taking that chance on.

SCENE 13 - INT. ALICE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

They sit on the couch, watching a movie. They laugh and snuggle, enjoying each other's company.

ALICE
(looking at him)
I love you, James.

JAMES
(looking at her)
I love you, Alice.

SCENE 14 - EXT. BEACH - DAY

They sit on the beach, watching the waves roll in.

ALICE
(looking at him)
I never thought I'd find someone who understands me like you do.

JAMES
(looking at her)
And I never thought I'd find someone who makes me feel the way you do.

They share a moment of silence, enjoying the peace and tranquility of the beach.

SCENE 15 - INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

They lie in bed, looking at each other.

ALICE
(whispering)
I never thought I'd have a second chance at love. But I'm so glad I did.

JAMES
(whispering)
Me too. And I promise to cherish every moment we have together.

They share a tender, loving kiss.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
